one_liner: Connect bank accounts to applications for transactions, balances, and identity verification.
auth_notes: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret sent either in the request body or via PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers.
access_notes: Sign up on the Plaid Dashboard to instantly get live client_id and secret keys for the Sandbox environment at no cost.
api_notes: JSON over HTTP REST API covering auth, balance, identity, transactions, investments, liabilities, and sandbox tools.
blocker_notes: Fully available via public self-serve sandbox API credentials.

auth.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret. These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET.

access.quote: To gain access to the Plaid API, create an account on the Plaid Dashboard. Once you've completed the signup process and acknowledged our terms, we'll provide a live client_id and secret via the Dashboard.

api.quote: The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP. Requests are POST requests, and responses are JSON, with errors indicated in response bodies as error_code and error_type

mcp.quote: Pssst -- I also moonlight as your IDE's research librarian! Plug me in via the Plaid MCP Server

verdict.quote: Plaid has two environments: Sandbox and Production. Items cannot be moved between environments. The Sandbox environment supports only test Items.
